events.title: Godmother to her nephew Friedrich
events.description: Godmother at the baptism of Friedrich, son of Maria Anna Birkenmaier, whom her brother Friedrich Mayer acknowledged. [R4-S1]

bio: In January 1862 Sophie, then 30, was unmarried and in domestic service at Freiburg. She came home to Munzingen to be godmother to her brother Friedrich's first child, born before the parents' marriage ([R4-S1]).
